items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: And Miss Tezon, that's why she used to teach from, uh, chart to second.

ctx.x: I don't know if that neighborhood is in Durbanee.

This hall was between Biannville, on there between Biannville and Iberville, right back of the church. They had a school there. And when my mother brought me to school, the teacher who stays on asked her, I said, what other school I had attended? She said, I had never attended no school. She said, oh, what a pity. She said, how old is her? I said, ten years old. She said, what a pity. She said, boy, ten years old, I'd never been to school. And so, mother said, no. She said, I didn't want to send them to public…
I said, no, ma'am. She said, well, we taught you how to read like that.
